notes.title: Accessibility update
notes.notes:
Based on your feedback, I've worked to add many accessibility features to the demo:     

A Light Theme is now available for those of you who prefer to read dark text on a light background rather than the opposite

The game now automatically saves on Exit and after every choice 

A "Resume" button was added to the main menu; it will load your latest save (either manual or automatic) 

Font choices and font size choices are now available through the Settings menu  

Speaking of menus, the main menu has been revamped

New buttons have been added to the quick menu: Back, Skip, Auto: to rewind, skip previously read text, and auto-forward the text, respectively; Rewind and Skip can be activated with the mouse/keyboard with the scroll-wheel and the Ctrl/Cmd keys  

The game should now be fully playable with a controller, with the exception of the name input at the start of the game.
